content: मीमांसा [मान्-विचारे स्वार्थे सन् अ] .²1 Deep reflection, inquiry, examination, investigation; अथातो व्रतमीमांसा <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 5. 21</ls>; रसगङ्गाधरनाम्नीं करोति कुतुकेन काव्यमीमांसाम् <ls>R. G.</ls>; सैषा आनन्दस्य मीमांसा भवति <ls>T. Up.</ls>; so दत्तक˚, अलंकार˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the six chief {%darśanas%} or systems of Indian philosophy. (It was originally divided into two systems:-- the पूर्वमीमांसा or कर्ममीमांसा founded by Jaimini, and the उत्तरमीमांसा or ब्रह्ममीमांसा ascribed to Bādarāyaṇa; but the two systems have very little in common between them, the first concerning itself chiefly with the correct interpretation of the ritual of the Veda and the settlement of dubious points in regard to Vedic texts; and the latter dealing chiefly with the nature of Brahman or the Supreme Spirit. The पूर्वमीमांसा is, therefore, usually, styled only मीमांसा or {%the%} Mīmāṃsā, and the उत्तरमीमांसा, वेदान्त which, being hardly a sequel of Jaiminiʼs system, is now considered and ranked separately.) मीमांसाकृतमुन्ममाथ सहसा हस्ती मुनिं जैमिनिम् <ls>Pt. 2. 34</ls>.
